Final hypothesis (data-grounded):

Only 1 of the 18 original Experimental Economics ('ee') studies in the dataset (~5.6%) was conducted in the United Kingdom — specifically, 'Deferred compensation in multiperiod labor contracts: an experimental test of Lazear's model' (AER 2011, id ee.13). The United States was by far the dominant location, hosting 11 of the 18 original studies (~61.1%), with the remainder in Germany (2), Switzerland (2), Australia (1), and Austria (1). The denominator is all 18 EE original studies, all of which have a recorded country; the location measured is experiment_country.o (country where the original experiment was conducted).
